battle.name: 王萬昌起義
battle.brief: 隋大業六年（610）十二月辛酉，珠崖郡（崖州，治邛都，今海南瓊海一帶）人王萬昌舉兵作亂反隋，隋煬帝遣隴西郡太守韓洪率兵南下，討平此亂。叛軍據海南嶺南山峒，官軍以郡兵合弩砲、投石機壓制。卡面這具羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）為扭力蓄能的單發重箭機，與中國床子弩同一原理，隋軍攻城器械多循此理。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰雙方：一方是隋朝中央調派的官軍，由隴西郡太守韓洪率領，編制上屬郡兵與州縣鎮兵，歸尚書省與行軍總管體系調度；另一方是珠崖郡（隋稱崖州，治邛都，今海南瓊海一帶）本地聚眾，以王萬昌為首的起義隊伍，並得到島上俚僚部族山寨的響應。隋承北周府兵之制，兵源於軍戶與編戶，行軍分材官（步卒）、騎兵、驃騎，郡置兵曹、縣置縣尉，各州鎮兵通常不過數千，實際戰力視主將與糧餉而定。海南一郡地處嶺南孤絕之地，郡兵單薄，守備以戍卒與峒寨互市為主，郡縣的實際控制力相當有限。叛軍則無正式編制，靠裹挾與響應擴張，作戰多在鄉里與山峒之間展開，隋廷視之為地方叛亂，經文牒層層上報，最後歸入兵部與中樞處置。
countriesEn: The two sides were: on one side the government troops dispatched by the Sui court, led by Han Hong, the governor of Longxi commandery, drawn from the commandery levies and the provincial and county garrison troops and moved through the Ministry of War and the wartime command structures; on the other side the insurgents of Zhuhai commandery (called Yazhou in Sui times, seated at Qiongdu, in the area of today's Qionghai on Hainan island), a locally raised force headed by Wang Wanchang that also drew support from the Shan villages of the Li and Liao peoples on the island. The Sui inherited the military registration system of the Northern Zhou, with troops drawn from military households and registered households, marching as engineers and infantry (caiguan), cavalry and light cavalry; commanderies had an office of military affairs and counties had a commandant, and the garrison of any one prefecture rarely exceeded a few thousand men, so real combat power depended on the commander and on supply. Hainan was a remote prefecture at the far southern edge of the empire, its commandery troops few, its garrison resting on the conscript soldiers and the trade with the hill villages, and the practical reach of the county and commandery administration was limited. The insurgents had no formal establishment at all, swelling through enlistment by force and through answering calls, and their fighting took place among the villages and in the hills. The Sui court treated the rising as a local disturbance, reported it upward through the document chain, and finally handled it in the Ministry of War and the central secretariat.
people: 關鍵人物：王萬昌，珠崖郡人，生卒年不詳，事蹟僅數十字見於《隋書》煬帝本紀與《隋書·韓擒虎列傳》，是隋末民變最早期的代表之一。韓洪，字叔明，隴西郡太守，隋朝名將韓擒虎的季弟；擒虎乃開皇年間滅陳的主將，韓洪自北周末年隨兄效力，以勇力善戰聞名，官至郡守，晚年奉詔南下平叛。此外還有大批未具名的郡兵將佐、縣吏與被裹挾的鄉民：起義爆發時，郡丞與縣令一級的官署反應遲緩，後來的鎮軍與州兵指揮系統亦屢屢奉命，說明隋末地方軍政的運作全靠文書往來與臨時調度。更大的背景人物是隋煬帝楊廣，以及同期在山東、河北、瓦崗、黎陽起兵的王薄、竇建德、翟讓、楊玄感等——正是這些人把王萬昌這種孤地方起義推入了更大的亂局之中。
peopleEn: The key figures: Wang Wanchang, a native of Zhuhai commandery, whose dates of birth and death are unknown and whose deeds survive in only a few dozen characters in the chronicle of Emperor Yang and in the biography of Han Qinhu in the Book of Sui; he was among the earliest of the late Sui rebellions. Han Hong, courtesy name Shuming, governor of Longxi commandery, was the youngest brother of the Sui general Han Qinhu, the commander who destroyed the Chen state in the Kaihuang era; Han Hong had served alongside his elder brother from the closing years of the Northern Zhou, was known for courage and prowess in arms, rose to the post of commandery governor, and in his later years was ordered south to put down the revolt. Around them stood the unnamed commandery officers, county functionaries and conscripted villagers: when the rising began, the offices of the commandery deputy and the county magistrate reacted slowly, and the district garrison and prefectural troop command systems were repeatedly ordered into action, showing that late Sui local military administration ran on paperwork and ad hoc dispatch. The larger figure behind the scene was Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, together with contemporaries who rose in Shandong, in Hebei, at Wagang and at Liyang — Wang Bo, Dou Jiande, Zhai Rang and Yang Xuanggan — and it was they who pushed a local rising like Wang Wanchang's into a far larger upheaval.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬弩砲（Scorpio），即以扭力蓄能的單發重箭機，公元前二世紀已在羅馬軍中服役，攻城時置於陣前或城頭，對城牆上密集的人馬作遠程壓制。與它原理相通的，是中國自漢末三國即已成熟的弩機技術：床子弩、弩砲，把強弩固定在車架、檯座或城堞上，靠絞鍵蓄力，一次發射一支粗壯的弩矢。中國古籍所見的「弩砲」「彀弩」正屬此類，隋代州郡與行軍都配備這類固定射擊器械，並與投石機（砲、飛石）、巢車、雲梯、衝車構成攻城器械群。與此同時，隋軍的野戰裝備是蹶張弩、擘張弩這類手扣發射的輕型弩機，配長槊、方盾與騎兵；叛軍一方則以柴刀、擔矛、弓箭、漁獵陷阱為主，島上俚人擅長毒箭與封路，缺鋼缺甲，海上運輸靠小型舟船。由此看，羅馬弩砲在這場戰役裏只能作為技術同類的對照：它代表「把弩固定下來、一次重擊」的兵器思路，而隋軍真正用來壓制峒寨與城鎮的，仍是本土的弩砲與投石機。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scorpio, a single-shot heavy bolt-thrower storing power in twisted skeins, already in Roman service by the second century BC; in sieges it was set up before the line or on the ramparts to deliver long-range suppression against the crowded defenders on a wall. Technically parallel to it is the Chinese crossbow machinery, mature in China since the late Han and the Three Kingdoms: the bed crossbow and the crossbow ballista, which fixed a powerful crossbow onto a cart frame, a platform or a parapet, wound a winch to store the energy and loosed one heavy bolt at a time. The Chinese records call such machines crossbow ballistae and torsion bows, and Sui prefectures and field armies were equipped with this kind of fixed firing machine, which together with the traction trebuchet, siege towers, scaling ladders and battering rams formed the siege train of the age. Alongside it, the field kit of the Sui army was the light crossbows held by hand and released by a trigger mechanism, the long spear, the rectangular shield and the cavalry; the insurgents on the other side had little more than woodcutters' blades, hunting spears, bows and arrows, and traps used in fishing and hunting, since the Li people of the island were skilled with poisoned arrows and in closing passes; they lacked steel and armour, and moved supplies by small boats along the coast. Seen this way, the Roman scorpio can serve here only as a technical analogy: it represents the idea of fixing a crossbow in place and striking once with a heavy bolt, while the machines the Sui army actually used to suppress the hill villages and walled towns remained the native crossbow ballista and the traction trebuchet.
tactics: 叛軍的戰術建立在海南的地形之上。珠崖一郡多山，黎峒村落依嶺而居，道路狹窄而多斷，密林與瘴癘令大隊人馬難以展開，糧秣又難以從內地運入；義軍因此避開官軍的正面推進，改為據守山寨、封鎖嶺口、襲擊縣治與倉場，同時破壞驛道與海運卸貨點，逼朝廷無法就地供應。作戰以夜襲與突擊為主，擊潰守備薄弱的縣鎮後即帶走糧食與器械，並不戀戰。官軍那邊，韓洪自隴西率兵南下，行軍依海道與山道分進，逐縣肅清、據城設站，切斷島上各處山寨的聯絡；攻城與攻寨時以弩砲、投石機在遠處壓制寨門與城頭，迫其無法上城射擊，再以步卒持盾進逼，騎兵斷其退路。韓洪所部依漢地郡兵的老辦法作戰：結陣、列械、穩紮，不得已而後進，糧道依海運與後方接濟。這種以正兵壓制的方法在隋代是常規，但遇上四出游擊的寨兵，效率極低。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents were built on the terrain of Hainan. Zhuhai commandery was mountainous, the Li villages clung to the ridges, the roads were narrow and often broken, and the dense forest and the miasma made it hard for large bodies of men to deploy, while grain was difficult to bring in from the interior. The rebels therefore avoided the frontal advance of the government troops and instead held the hill stockades, sealed the passes, raided the county seats and the granaries, and at the same time wrecked the post roads and the sea-side landing points to deny the court any local supply. Their fighting was built on night attacks and sudden sallies: after breaking a thinly held county town they carried off grain and gear and did not linger. On the government side, Han Hong marched south from Longxi, splitting his force between the coast road and the mountain tracks, clearing county by county, holding towns and staging posts, and cutting the links between the scattered stockades. When he attacked a fort or a village he used crossbow ballistae and traction trebuchets at long range to beat down the gate and the parapet and prevent the defenders from shooting from above, then advanced with shield-bearing infantry while cavalry cut off the way back. Han Hong's men fought in the old Han fashion of commandery levies: forming up, deploying the engines, holding a firm camp, and advancing only when they had to, with the supply line resting on the sea and on support from the rear. This method of crushing by regular troops was standard in the Sui, but against raiding stockade fighters its efficiency was very low.
data: 可查證的數字有限，先說能確定的：隋煬帝大業六年第一次征高句麗，集天下兵渡海者三十餘萬，士卒死者十四五，也就是十數萬人埋骨異域；次年再發六十萬；第三年傾國而出，號稱百十三萬，糧餉與兵械都難以支應，而死亡比例仍被史官記在「十四五」一線。人口與賦役方面，《隋書·食貨志》所載開皇季年的全國戶口約八百九十萬戶、四千六百餘萬口，經大業年間的兵役與徭役，逃戶與死亡使實數銳減，至隋亡時已遠不及此。地理數字：韓洪治所隴西郡在今甘肅中部，直線到珠崖郡治邛都約五千里，山路與海路都更遠，這決定了調兵遲滯、援軍難繼。而起義本身的關鍵數字史籍未載：《隋書》只記韓洪奉詔討平王萬昌，既沒有叛軍眾數，也沒有戰損、俘虜與器械的記錄，兩軍人數與攻城器械數量皆不可考。羅馬弩砲這類器械的規格同樣沒有確數，史家估算其有效射程在數百米之內、單矢重量以公斤計；中國床子弩的常見射程則在兩三百步上下。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, so start with what can be fixed. In the first campaign against Goguryeo in the sixth year of the Daye era, Emperor Yang mustered the armies of the whole empire, more than three hundred thousand men crossed the sea, and the Book of Sui records that of the soldiers four or five in ten died, that is, some hundred thousand men were buried abroad; the following year sixty thousand more were raised, and the third year the empire was emptied out with a claimed force of one million one hundred and thirty thousand, when both supply and weapons could barely be sustained, the same record of deaths at four or five in ten being kept. On population and taxation, the Book of Sui, in the Treatise on Food and Revenue, gives for the closing years of the Kaihuang era roughly eight million nine hundred thousand households and forty-six million mouths, and after the levies and labours of the Daye years, flight from the registers and deaths cut the real figures sharply, so that by the fall of the Sui they were far below that. A geographical figure: Longxi commandery, where Han Hong was governor, lies in the middle of what is now Gansu, and the straight line to Qiongdu, the seat of Zhuhai commandery, runs about five thousand li, further by mountain track and longer again by sea, which is what made the dispatch of troops slow and relief hard to sustain. The key figures of the rising itself are simply not recorded: the Book of Sui says only that Han Hong was sent to put Wang Wanchang down, and gives neither the size of the rebel force nor the losses, prisoners and captured equipment on either side, so the numbers of men and of siege engines are simply not recoverable. The specifications of machines of the scorpio type are likewise not exact; historians estimate an effective range of a few hundred metres and a single bolt weighing on the order of kilograms, while the usual range of the Chinese bed crossbow is around two to three hundred paces.
cause: 起義的直接背景是隋朝在鼎盛表象下已經失控的國家動員。隋煬帝即位後把大量財力與人力投向東都洛陽、顯仁宮與江都的宮殿，又開鑿運河、造龍舟，役使的徵發按戶均派；大業六年起對高句麗的三次大舉，兵役遠超隋代前期任何一次戰爭，死傷以「十四五」計，剩下的兵卒與民戶在田間與工役之間被來回抽調。海南珠崖一郡，屬嶺南極邊，郡縣官僚既要完成中央攤派的漕運與雜役，又要管束島上俚僚諸部，商人與鹽戶的盤剝、田租與力役的加派，讓「括戶」「自首」一類的命令在島上難以實行。往北看，黃河南北同樣有水旱與饑饉，山東的饑民在王薄手下聚眾起事。地方社會的反抗因此不是孤立事件：大業六年前後，山東、河北、江南一帶相繼出現小股聚眾，郡縣武備被抽調到遼東戰線，防守空虛，於是珠崖的王萬昌在十二月辛酉舉兵，把積怨變成一次有旗號的武裝行動。
causeEn: The immediate background of the rising was a state mobilisation that had already run out of control beneath the appearance of Sui prosperity. After taking the throne, Emperor Yang devoted enormous wealth and manpower to the eastern capital at Luoyang, to the Xianren Palace, and to the palace complexes at Jiangdu; he cut the Grand Canal and built his dragon boats, and the corvée levies were assessed household by household. The three great campaigns against Goguryeo that began in the sixth year of Daye imposed a military service far heavier than anything in the earlier Sui, with deaths running at four or five in ten, while the surviving soldiers and households were pulled back and forth between the fields and the works. Zhuhai commandery in Hainan lay at the far southern limit of the empire: its commandery and county officials had both to meet the central quotas for water transport and assorted labour and to keep control over the Li and Liao peoples of the island, and the exploitation by merchants and salt dealers and the surcharges on land tax and labour made orders such as the registering of households and the voluntary surrenders of hidden ones almost impossible to carry out there. Further north, drought and flood and famine afflicted the Yellow River plains as well, and hungry men in Shandong rose in bands under Wang Bo. The resistance of local society was therefore not an isolated event: in the years around the sixth of Daye, small bands appeared successively in Shandong, in Hebei and in Jiangnan, the garrisons of the commanderies and counties had been stripped to feed the war fronts in Liaodong, and the defences stood empty. It was into this opening that Wang Wanchang of Zhuhai marched out on the xinyou day of the twelfth month, turning long smouldering resentment into an armed act with a banner over it.
impact: 這場起義本身的戰果有限，卻在隋末的亂序裡留下清楚的水位線。珠崖之亂說明一件事：大業年間的隋朝在中原尚能調動大軍，在嶺南卻只剩郡兵可用，朝廷對邊郡的控制靠的是文牒、鹽利與地方部族的合作，而非常備武力。郡兵平叛之後，朝廷並未在海南增防，也沒有改變攤派方式，這次平定因此只是把問題推後數年——隨著竇建德在河北、翟讓在瓦崗、楊玄感在黎陽、杜明威在泗州相繼舉事，隋朝的統治在半個中國崩解，618年江都之變中楊廣被宇文化及所殺，隋亡；同年李淵建唐。海南的走向也受同一大潮牽動，隋末唐初的高涼冼夫人與廣州馮盎勢力在珠崖、崖州一帶重新劃界，島上原有的部族秩序與郡縣體系在此後數十年裡反覆重組，一個起義者的名字雖然被正史壓成一行，但珠崖的縣、州的行政與軍事安排正是被這些動盪重新寫過。
impactEn: The military results of the rising were modest, yet it left a clear waterline in the disorder of late Sui. The revolt at Zhuhai demonstrated one thing: in the Daye years the Sui could still move great armies in the central plain, but in Lingnan nothing was left but the commandery levies, and the court's control of the frontier commanderies rested on documents, on the salt monopoly and on cooperation with the local peoples rather than on any standing force. After the levies had suppressed the rising, the court neither reinforced the garrison in Hainan nor changed the way the levies were apportioned, so the suppression merely pushed the problem back some years. As Dou Jiande rose in Hebei, Zhai Rang at Wagang, Yang Xuanggan at Liyang and Du Mingwei in Suzhou, the Sui order collapsed across half of China; in the mutiny at Jiangdu in 618 Yang Guang was killed by Yuwen Huaji and the dynasty ended, and in the same year Li Yuan founded the Tang. The course of Hainan was pulled by the same tide: in the closing years of the Sui and the opening of the Tang, the power of the Lady Xian of Gaoliang and of Feng Ang of Guangzhou redrew the boundaries around Zhuhai and Yazhou, and the tribal order and the commandery-and-county system of the island were reorganised again and again over the following decades. The name of a single rebel was compressed by the official histories into a single line, but the administrative and military arrangements of the commanderies and prefectures of Zhuhai were precisely what those upheavals rewrote.
result: 結局記載簡短：韓洪奉詔率兵南下，討平王萬昌，珠崖的郡縣秩序恢復，叛軍在隋廷的檔案裡被記為一場已經解決的地方叛亂。《隋書》沒有寫王萬昌的下落，也沒有記他被斬、被俘還是流散，因此這個人的結局至今無從確認，只能確定的是他沒有再成為任何一支反隋力量的領袖，名字在隋亡之後便從正史的記錄裡消失。戰役的過程同樣缺乏細節，無從確定是攻城戰、山地伏擊還是兩軍在曠野對壘，官軍是否真的動用了弩砲與投石機、叛軍眾數幾何，都只能依隋代一般攻城與平叛的常例推測。從更大的格局看，這是一次成功的鎮壓：說明大業末年隋廷在多數州郡仍握有調兵與守城的餘力，說明邊郡的起義在初起階段仍可被迅速壓服。但同一套郡兵體系在三年後面對全國性的叛軍已無力支應，618年隋室覆亡，這場十餘年前在海南短暫平息的亂事，於是成了隋朝崩解過程中最先被壓住、卻也最先被忘記的一環。
resultEn: The record of the outcome is brief: Han Hong was ordered to march south with troops, put Wang Wanchang down, the administrative order of Zhuhai was restored, and in the archives of the Sui court the insurgents were entered as a local disturbance already settled. The Book of Sui does not give the fate of Wang Wanchang, nor does it say whether he was beheaded, taken prisoner or scattered, so the end of this man cannot be confirmed; the only certainty is that he never became the leader of any further anti-Sui force, and after the fall of the dynasty his name disappears from the official record. The course of the fighting is equally thin: it cannot be determined whether this was a siege, an ambush in the hills, or a pitched battle on open ground, and whether the government army really brought up crossbow ballistae and traction trebuchets, and how many the insurgents numbered, can only be inferred from the general practice of sieges and pacification in the Sui. On the larger scale this was a successful suppression: it shows that in the late Daye years the Sui court still had the margin to move troops and hold towns in most prefectures, and that a rising in a frontier commandery could still be crushed quickly in its first stages. Yet the same commandery system, three years later, could no longer support the nationwide rebellions, and in 618 the Sui house fell. This disturbance, briefly extinguished in Hainan a dozen years earlier, thus became the first link to be pinned down, and the first to be forgotten, in the unravelling of the Sui.
